first_public_date_evidence: OpenAlex W2142084183 records 2002-01-01; journal and PubMed establish January 2002 only, so first-of-month is an index convention rather than a verified dissemination day.

integrity.computation: one exact symbolic proof identity plus auxiliary numerical checks; these do not substitute for the analytic theorem
integrity.public_date_precision: source index normalizes publication month to first day

scientific_limitations: Only the specified pair of two-component nine-site binary profiles, their positive integer repetitions, and deterministic linear homogeneous nearest-neighbor diffusion are covered. No nonlinear/stochastic persistence or general optimizer is proved. The numerical root is approximate; analytic uniqueness is exact. Abstract-only primary-source coverage may miss a stronger result.
title: Unique dispersal crossover in equally fragmented cyclic habitats
